title: Unconscious (status group)
html:
Unconscious is a status group.

List of conditions in Unconscious

Condition Effects
Blacked Out
  • Thisobald has overindulged in his own brew. He has a -5 penalty to Armour Class and is Vulnerable to Slashing, Piercing, Bludgeoning and Thunder Damage.
Command: Grovel
  • Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on  Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws.
  • Attacks against a grovelling creature have  Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature.
Downed
  • If you reach 0 hit points, you fall Unconscious and must make Death Saving Throws. On 3 successes, you stop bleeding out and become Stable. On 3 failures, you  die.
  • Any damage you receive while unconscious counts as one failure.
  • If you regain any Hit Points, the condition is removed. If an ally helps you, you regain 1 hit point.
Ether-Essence Slumber
  • A deep, dream-ridden sleep has overcome the creature, induced by judicious ingesting of Ether.
  • The creature cannot move or act.
  • The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity  Saving Throws.
  •  Attack Rolls against the creature have  Advantage
  • Removed by taking damage or being Shoved.
Fiendish Obeisance: Kneel
  • Affected entity has been compelled to kneel by a fiend. It cannot move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions, and has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Saving Throws.
  • Attacks against it have  Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the entity. The entity must spend half its movement speed to stand up.
Hideous Laughter
  • Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on  Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws.
  • Attacks against a Prone creature have  Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature.
  • At the end of its turn or when it takes damage, the entity can try to shake off the effect.
Hoots' Hooch: Blackout
  • Character is unconscious.
Hysterical
  • Knocked Prone out of sheer elation. Sides splitting, lungs gasping for air - you're enjoying yourself, aren't you?
Impenetrable slumber
  • This individual is under the influence of copious sleeping draughts. It is impossible to wake them.
Potion of Angelic Relief
  • Affected entity falls asleep for 2 rounds. When it wakes up, it receives the effects of a Short Rest and all 1st and 2nd level spell slots are restored.
  • If interrupted before the duration expires, the effects will not apply.
Potion of Angelic Slumber
  • Affected entity falls asleep for 2 rounds. When it wakes up, it receives the effects of a Long Rest. If interrupted before the duration expires, the effects do not apply.
Prone
  • Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Saving Throws.
  • Attacks against a Prone creature have  Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature.
  • A Prone creature must spend half its  Movement Speed to stand up.
  • Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration.
  • If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends.
Sapped

Target has been psionically drained.

Sleeping
  • A sleeping creature cannot move or act.
  • Moreover, the creature automatically fails  Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws.
  •  Attack Rolls against it have  Advantage, and any attack that hits the creature is a critical hit if the attacker is within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the creature.
  • Removed by taking damage, becoming wet, receiving  Help or being  Shoved.
Stricken with Drow Poison
  • Affected entity is  Poisoned and has fallen  Asleep.
  • Lasts until affected entity has made a successful  Constitution Saving Throw or takes damage.
Unconscious
  • Character is unconscious.
  • The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity  Saving Throws.
  •  Attack Rolls within 3 m (10 ft) automatically Critical Hit
